subject: Representation creation
trigger: Actor proposes to act for principal
required_inputs: Canonical parties; source basis; capacity; scope; purpose; time; accountable actor

subject: Representation acceptance
trigger: Acceptance is required by source rule
required_inputs: Current proposal; accepting principal/actor; assurance; restrictions
prohibited_behavior: Acceptance inferred from silence login payment or portal use

subject: Guardian representation
trigger: Guardian requests action for protected participant
required_inputs: Current representation basis; agreement/consent; safeguarding restrictions; purpose
allowed_transition: PROVISIONAL to ACTIVE when all sources permit
prohibited_behavior: Shared address family label or payer status creating authority

subject: Organization representation
required_inputs: Organization authority source; accountable human; scope; acceptance
prohibited_behavior: Email domain or organization membership creating authority

subject: Provider representation
required_inputs: Provider relationship; organization/human identity; representation basis; purpose
prohibited_behavior: Profile API key appointment payment or portal status creating authority
evidence: Provider principal chain; GFD-003 scope; versions

subject: Delegation proposal
required_inputs: Current source authority; delegate; action/resource/field/purpose/time scope; restrictions

subject: Delegation acceptance
required_inputs: Current proposal; eligible delegate; assurance; restrictions
prohibited_behavior: Acceptance inferred from use schedule payment or portal

subject: Delegation narrowing
trigger: Delegator or controlling restriction narrows scope
required_inputs: Current grant; current source; narrower scope; reason

subject: Delegation expiry
required_inputs: Grant expiry; trusted time; current watermark

subject: Delegation revocation
required_inputs: Current grant; revoker basis; reason; affected scope

subject: Delegation dispute
required_inputs: Grant; claimant; claim/evidence refs; protective rule
prohibited_behavior: Automatic dispute resolution or privilege expansion

subject: Source authority loss
trigger: Relationship representation agreement or principal authority ends
evidence: Source event; affected grant list; watermark

subject: Delegation correction
trigger: Material source or record error is corrected
required_inputs: Original grant; correction basis; accountable actor
allowed_transition: Any non-terminal state to SUPERSEDED plus successor
prohibited_behavior: Deleting original grant or rewriting evidence
